Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: In the absence of a provision to the contrary in the articles of incorporation, the directors of a corporation elected for a specified term

Options: 
A. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, but only with a two-thirds majority vote.
B. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, but only if they fail to attend three consecutive meetings without a reasonable excuse.
C. cannot be removed from office prior to the expiration of their term.
D. can only be removed from office by the board of directors, not the shareholders.
E. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, with or without cause.
F. can be removed from office prior to the expiration of their term only by a decree of the circuit court in an action by the shareholders.
G. can be removed from office only by a unanimous vote of the shareholders, with or without cause.
H. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, but only for cause and after an opportunity to be heard has been given to the directors.
I. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, but only for cause.
J. can be removed from office at a meeting of the shareholders, but only if a replacement director has been identified.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
